h: The Eighth Day Establishes the Joy of Divine Presence

p: "And it came to pass on the eighth day" (Vayikra 9:1).
"Why does the Torah say 'and it came to pass' (vayehi)?
For there was joy before Him on high
as on the day heaven and earth were created:
regarding the work of Creation it says,
וַיְהִי עֶרֶב וַיְהִי בוֹקֶר (בְּרֵאשִׁית א, ה)
'And it was evening and it was morning' (Bereishis 1:5),
and here it says 'and it came to pass'"
וּבְמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה יא, ז)
And in the Midrash Rabbah (on this parsha, Vayikra Rabbah 11:7):
יְהִי אוֹר וַיְהִי אוֹר (בְּרֵאשִׁית א, ג)
"'Let there be light, and there was light' (Bereishis 1:3)!"
because the world did not merit
to make use of that light.
אוֹר שֶׁבָּרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא כוּ׳
The light that the Holy One, blessed be He, created," etc.,
"He arose and hid it from them," etc.;
and for the upright of heart, joy.'"
This is that "tzaddikim are for light"
A tzaddik is what one is called
and for this "Torah, light" (Mishlei 6:23) is needed,
in the utterance "Let there be light"
correspond to the five books of the Torah
And the light that was hidden,
He hid it in Gan Eden;
and the tzaddik is called the gardener of the garden
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זוֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קסו, ב)
And had there been revealed each day
only, woe to the generation of the Flood
and the generation of the Dispersion,
for whose sake He hid it.
and for them it truly is joy;
as "'Let there be light' — this is Avraham"
"And from the wicked their light is withheld"
וְכֵן וַיְהִי עֶרֶב וַיְהִי בוֹקֶר יוֹם אֶחָד
And likewise "And it was evening and it was morning, one day":
"'And it was evening' — for the wicked;
for the tzaddikim it is joy.
what is said, "And it came to pass on the eighth day,"
(as the holy Zohar too was precise about this);
and on this, vayehi is an expression of joy,
for then there was an existence
as on the day of the creation of heaven and earth;
only it was "woe" to the nations of the world.
And it is written "on the eighth day,"
for the seven days were a preparation for this;
for during the seven days of inauguration
and they were only a preparation
for "and it came to pass on the eighth day";
for on the eighth there came into being
that the Shechinah should rest among the lower beings.
And although the House was destroyed,
since the holiness was established forever.
And there was joy before Him on high,
and it is "woe" to the nations of the world;
for then there was the union,
לְיִיחוּד קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּכְנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל
for the union of the Holy One, blessed be He, and Knesses Yisrael,
and Yisrael is "one nation in the land" (Shmuel II 7:23).
וּשְׁלֹמֹה הַמֶּלֶךְ אָמַר עַל דּוֹרוֹ (מִשְׁלֵי לא, כט)
And King Shlomo said of his generation (Mishlei 31:29):
similar to what is expounded in the Gemara (Sanhedrin 20a):
about the generation of Moshe and Yehoshua."
that his generation was "a woman who fears Hashem,"
for in his time was built
and not like the generation of Moshe,
who did not merit that Moshe enter the Land
who brought them into the Land
nevertheless his generation did not merit
the building of the Beis HaMikdash.
And nevertheless he said to them (Shir HaShirim 3:11):
who merited the building of the Beis HaMikdash
Tziyon, the dwelling place of Your glory
the One to Whom peace belongs;
"with the crown with which his mother crowned him"
on the day the Shechinah rested;
"and on the day of the joy of his heart"
on the day new fire descended from on high
And this is what is said, "And it came to pass on the eighth day":
the resting of the Shechinah among the lower beings,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁהָיָה בְּיוֹם בְּרִיאַת שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ
as it was on the day of the creation of heaven and earth,
that the Shechinah should rest among the lower beings
removed the Shechinah from the lower beings,
and for them there is no complete joy.
cause the Shechinah to dwell on earth;
and they merit "for the upright of heart, joy."
And for this the seven days were a preparation:
"and it came to pass on the eighth day,"
the resting of the Shechinah among the lower beings
and there was joy before Him on high.
